title: An unexpected throw during first load leaves the post loading forever
current: useSubGoalLoading turns request failures into an error state, but if runInit throws unexpectedly, the outer catch only logs to the browser console. loading stays true and no error is set, so the skeleton never goes away.
evidence: The .catch calls logDiagnostic and nothing else; setLoading(false) and setError run only inside runInit's own branches. requestJsonWithRetry returns failures as results, so this needs a throw from elsewhere (for example a header helper or a state setter).
investigate: Which calls inside runInit can throw (statisticsRequestHeaders, markInitStart, setState)?
Make the catch also set the load error and stop loading.
tests: useSubGoalLoading shows the load error when runInit throws unexpectedly.

criticality.why: Unlikely, but when it happens the post is stuck on a skeleton with no error and no server log.
